name: California State Parks Historian Passport
description: Free downloadable Historian Passport (normally $50) valid through the rest of 2026 at 30+ California state historic parks — free to download for a limited time through the Fourth of July weekend 2026.
fullDescription: The California State Parks Historian Passport is a special-edition pass offered free to download for a limited time in 2026. Normally $50, the passport is valid for the remainder of 2026 at more than 30 state historic parks throughout California, where visitors can explore the state's history. The free release is offered in connection with Juneteenth and the 250th anniversary of the United States.
